title: Download ZIP Path: reuse finish grade and avoid double compression

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.161 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

claims.summary: The release is grounded in fresh v0.15.160 GPT-5.4-mini evidence that reached visible 100/A with Texture 95 and clean digest gates.
The fresh run reproduced the user-facing defect: Download ZIP froze the tab and did not create a newer Downloads ZIP.
proofCommands: rg -n "Download ZIP clicks made the Chrome tab unresponsive|did not create a newer" docs/V0.15.161_DOWNLOAD_ZIP_STABILITY_ROADMAP.md

claims.summary: The export panel passes completed finish quality into the ZIP exporter, and the exporter embeds it into manifest/report output.
proofCommands: rg -n "precomputed|verified finish-pass quality result" src/components/ExportSidePanel.jsx src/lib/packageZipExporter.js src/lib/__tests__/packageZipExporter.test.js src/components/__tests__/ExportSidePanel.readiness.test.jsx

claims.summary: The outer course-materials ZIP uses STORE mode to avoid recompressing already-compressed Office package files on the browser main thread.
The release records GPT-5.4-mini as the default provider audit model and reserves GPT-5.5-pro for occasional comparison checks.

knownRemainingTargets: Fresh deployed v0.15.161 GPT-5.4-mini ZIP/log proof must confirm the download now creates a ZIP without Chrome Page Unresponsive.
The v0.15.160 visible 100/A digest is promising but is not a completed ZIP/local-regrade audit because the download path failed before file capture.
If v0.15.161 still freezes, the next slice should move ZIP assembly off the main thread rather than spending another provider generation.
